# Grok Bot Architecture

Pattern / reference (not a hosted OS): crew, shared computer, routines, connectors, HITL. Example host: Grok Bot (Cursor). Host is replaceable; layers stay vendor-agnostic.

Prove the contracts:

```text
node scripts/validate-all.mjs
```
